feeds.title: International Bipolar Foundation » Parenting
feeds.description: International Bipolar Foundation (IBPF), was founded in June 2007 in San Diego, California by four parents with children affected by bipolar disorder. IBPF provides a world of hope, articles, resources and support for bipolar parenting.

feeds.title: Jennifer Marshall Blog
feeds.description: Jenn Marshall writes about the challenges of bipolar disorder. She also co-founded This Is My Brave, Inc. which provides a platform for people to share their stories and end the stigma surrounding mental illness.

feeds.title: Kitt O'Malley » Bipolar Parenting
feeds.description: At kittomalley.com, Kitt writes about living with bipolar disorder, parenting a migraineur, loving parents with dementia, and grief at losing her father. Her varied career path has included working as a legal assistant, psychotherapist, and commercial real estate professional.

feeds.title: The Path Less Taken » bipolar
feeds.description: The Path Less Taken has a category on bipolar which gives an insight into the illness and what to do and what not to do while having bipolar disorder.

feeds.title: bpHope
feeds.description: BP Hope is bp Magazine's award-winning, online community. We strive to increase the awareness of the bipolar disorder. We also provide hope, empowerment & support for those living with bipolar & their loved ones. Get bipolar family support & learn how to nurture bipolar relationships.

feeds.title: The Bipolar Mama
feeds.description: Lauren Kocher is an author and a mother of two boys, wife, roller derby girl with bipolar disorder. She shares her every day with mental illness to help end stigma.
